verdict.rationale: Qodo is an AI code review platform with agentic features, so consuming external MCP servers is a fair axis for it. The evidence only documents Qodo acting as an MCP server: its Agentic Toolbox exposes Qodo skills to other agents. Its integrations (ticketing, Figma, Git providers) are native, and nothing shows users plugging in third-party MCP servers for Qodo to use.
